description.value: Spirits of the West Coast Art Gallery has been curating Pacific Northwest Coast Indigenous artwork and jewelry since 2006, showcasing original masks, paddles, Haida argillite carvings, totem poles, and silver and gold jewelry by master carvers from Haida, Kwakwaka'wakw, Coast Salish, and Nuu-chah-nulth nations. The gallery hosts rotating exhibitions and offers both in-person and virtual gallery tours, making it a substantive cultural stop on Vancouver Island. Commissions for custom carvings and jewelry are also available.
